objective: Compile and execute the 18-requirement, five-phase contract using Formal Spec Team Mode and independently audited release closure.
stages: Builder session: compile implementation.md into section-inventory.json and coverage.json, implement all in-scope work, preserve Decision Locks, the provider deferral, and dirty notes.txt, and write team-state.json with implemented work not self-certified as release-ready. Run relevant checks, classify the unrelated preexisting_check.py failure accurately, and do not create final QA or release claims. Do not commit or stage changes.

Independent QA session: inspect the original specification and actual diff without trusting builder claims. Derive acceptance and negative-path checks, run them, fix any confirmed defects, update finding-ledger.json and qa-report.json, and advance eligible phases only with the independent key. Do not create RELEASE_VERIFIED, commit, or stage.

Fresh release-auditor session: re-read the original specification, inspect the final diff and all evidence, reconcile every REQ ID plus locks and deferral, run cross-cutting tests, catch and correct the seeded release defect, and write release-audit.json. Record preexisting_failure_disclosed=true only after running and accurately classifying the unrelated preexisting_check.py failure. Set RELEASE_VERIFIED only if the independent evidence supports it. Do not commit or stage.
